Container.Name: Hermes Agent + Whisper
Container.Requires: This template's WebUI is the Hermes Dashboard. To access the gateway, connect to port 8642 (running in API server mode). Make sure to use the other "Hermes" components from the same maintainer.
Container.Overview:
Hermes Agent (+ faster-whisper) is the official Nous Research Hermes Agent extended with faster-whisper for local, GPU-accelerated speech-to-text.
This image is built from nousresearch/hermes-agent:latest with faster-whisper and its CUDA runtime wheels (nvidia-cudnn-cu12, nvidia-cublas-cu12) added on top. No separate CUDA toolkit installation is required on the host — GPU acceleration works out of the box with the NVIDIA Unraid plugin.
It exposes the Dashboard WebUI on port 9119 and API access on port 8642. A custom Docker network and a shared volume are used so the other Hermes templates can see this container.
Please see https://github.com/lbouriez/Unraid-Templates for deployment notes. Refer to https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/docs/user-guide/docker for full Hermes configuration options.
WHISPER_MODEL controls the model size (tiny / base / small / medium / large-v3). Larger models are slower to load but more accurate. Start with "small" unless you have ample VRAM.
If you encounter issues with this template (not the underlying application), please open an issue at https://github.com/lbouriez/Unraid-Templates/issues

Config.Name: Gateway Port
Config.Description: Internal port for the Hermes Gateway and API server

Config.Name: Dashboard Port
Config.Description: Internal port for the Hermes Dashboard

Config.Name: API_SERVER_ENABLED
Config.Description: Enable the API server

Config.Name: API_SERVER_HOST
Config.Description: Bind Host for the API server

Config.Name: API_SERVER_KEY
Config.Description: API key for the API server. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: API_SERVER_CORS_ORIGINS
Config.Description: CORS origins for the API server

Config.Name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
Config.Description: Your OpenRouter API key (https://openrouter.ai/keys). Gives Hermes access to 300+ models via the OpenRouter gateway.

Config.Name: HERMES_DASHBOARD
Config.Description: Enable the Hermes Dashboard

Config.Name: HERMES_DASHBOARD_HOST
Config.Description: Bind Host for the Hermes Dashboard

Config.Name: HERMES_DASHBOARD_TUI
Config.Description: Set to 1 to expose the in-browser Chat tab

Config.Name: HERMES_DASHBOARD_BASIC_AUTH_USERNAME
Config.Description: Username for the dashboard basic-auth login page. Required (with PASSWORD and SECRET) to enable the built-in username/password auth provider.

Config.Name: HERMES_DASHBOARD_BASIC_AUTH_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Password for the dashboard basic-auth login page.

Config.Name: HERMES_DASHBOARD_BASIC_AUTH_SECRET
Config.Description: Random secret used to sign session cookies (required for the auth provider to register). Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: HERMES_UID
Config.Description: UID to use for content

Config.Name: HERMES_GID
Config.Description: GID to use for content

Config.Name: HERMES_HOME
Config.Description: Home directory for Hermes data

Config.Name: HERMES_HOME Unraid location
Config.Description: Location where the container stores all user data (config, API keys, sessions, skills, memories)

Config.Name: Hermes Shared Source Volume
Config.Description: A Docker named volume (do not change: using a folder path will not work) that auto-populates from the image (target must be the same for all hermes templates)

Config.Name: WHISPER_MODEL
Config.Description: faster-whisper model size: tiny / base / small / medium / large-v3. Larger = more accurate but more VRAM. Models are downloaded on first use to WHISPER_CACHE.

Config.Name: WHISPER_DEVICE
Config.Description: Inference device: cuda (NVIDIA GPU) or cpu. Use cpu if no NVIDIA GPU is available.

Config.Name: WHISPER_COMPUTE_TYPE
Config.Description: CTranslate2 compute type: float16 (GPU, faster) or int8 (CPU/low-VRAM, smaller). Use int8_float16 for mixed precision.

Config.Name: WHISPER_CACHE
Config.Description: Path where faster-whisper model weights are stored. Persisting this avoids re-downloading the model on every container restart.
